newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA GOLD SHARES SLIP, BONDS BOOST INDUSTRIALS.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA GOLD SHARES SLIP, BONDS BOOST INDUSTRIALS.

text.p: 1017 GMT - Robust South African long bonds underpins gains in industrial shares at noon as heavyweight share Richemont holds strong levels. Gold shares droop, taking index to fresh 4 -1/4 year low as bullion bleeds around $331.

* Dealers say arbitrage trading between futures and spot market also propping up shares, steady rand comforting following concerns may weaken after easing of foreign exchange controls on individuals on Tuesday.

* Turnover moderate at around 380 million rand. Big volumes seen in industrial firm and penny stock Corpgro which trades 8.9 million shares, lifting price two cents to 35 cents. Corpgro said earlier it plans a 9-for-1 share consolidation.
* Gold index off 12.5 points at 956.1 as Freegold loses 15 cents to 22.50 rand. Industrial index up 20.2 to 8,828.9 and all-shares lose 8.7 to 7,411.4.
